description: Git-tracked preparation record for a transactional installer that integrates the disabled Claude child-session broker posture into the four real global policy surfaces (canonical policy, golden policy, verifier, integrity manifest). The local broker module is a read-only prerequisite: this package never rewrites it. A future --apply installs ONLY this disabled posture, atomically across all four surfaces, with prehash checks, backup, idempotency, verifier re-validation, and rollback. The verifier patch is wired into run_all(spec) as a real POLICY-54-style check, not merely defined.

broker_prerequisite.description: Read-only prerequisite. Never written by this package.

verifier_patch.function_template:
# BEGIN claudeChildBroker verifier check (managed by disabled-child-broker.json, do not hand-edit)
def check_claude_child_broker(checks, spec):
    """POLICY-54: claudeChildBroker is present in canonical policy and strictly disabled."""
    expected = {expected_literal}
    cid, target, expectation = "POLICY-54", CANONICAL_POLICY, "claudeChildBroker is present and strictly disabled"
    try:
        live = read_json(CANONICAL_POLICY)
    except LoadError as exc:
        checks.append(Check(cid, target, expectation, False, f"canonical policy unreadable: {{exc}}"))
        return
    obj = live.get("claudeChildBroker")
    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
        checks.append(Check(cid, target, expectation, False, "claudeChildBroker missing or not an object"))
        return
    mismatches = [f"{{k}}={{obj.get(k)!r}} (want {{v!r}})" for k, v in expected.items() if obj.get(k) != v]
    broker_path = Path(expected.get("brokerModulePath", ""))
    broker_ok = broker_path.exists() and sha256_file(broker_path) == expected.get("brokerModuleSha256")
    if not broker_ok:
        mismatches.append("broker module missing or hash mismatch")
    ok = not mismatches
    checks.append(Check(cid, target, expectation, ok, "matches expected disabled posture" if ok else "; ".join(mismatches)))
# END claudeChildBroker verifier check
verifier_patch.call_statement: check_claude_child_broker(checks, spec)  # managed by disabled-child-broker.json (claudeChildBroker, POLICY-54)
